description.value: DAAN Korean Cuisine is an authentic Korean restaurant that has been serving Richmond since 2017, with a menu built around bold dishes like Bulgogi, Bossam, and Octopus Hotpot made from fresh ingredients. Situated in a plaza on Blundell Road, it draws a loyal local following and offers both a full dine-in experience and online ordering for pickup or delivery. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's residential core would find it a convenient stop for a substantial sit-down or takeout Korean meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 71m; rack at 78m.
